body:
Quick pass done on 56f26bda.
- Merges cleanly with main: upstream main a0891091 is in the branch, and nothing newer has landed. A trial merge with #1034's head 5d8b71e2 is clean too.
- Pinning test `probe_spindle_stop` (doosan-dnm in `MILL_POSTS`, both tests) is green on this head; it failed on main. Every app suite that posts through doosan-dnm or probes (17 suites) is green, the post crate's 66 tests pass, and clippy `-D warnings` is clean. The quick gate is green but plans almost nothing for a `.cps` change (#923), which is why the suites were picked by hand.
- The body is complete: what changed, how it was tested, what was not exercised, `Changelog:`, `Fixes #1035`.
- Laws: no snapshot PNG touched; a decision file; the post script is exempt from the 400-line rule.

Flagging ready for review. It changes posted G-code (under the safety floor), so per the effort table the review should run at the high tier.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 56f26bdaec419f97aa54d9fbca35f46b32afe984 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Trial-merged with current main (5bdfc00c). The merge was clean; `doosan-dnm.cps` auto-merged with today's #1019/#1072 changes. I re-read `startPreamble` in the merged file, not only on the PR head.

### What looks good
- The new line (`doosan-dnm.cps:556` in the merged file) comes after `T M6` / `G43 H` and the skipped S/M3, and before the conveyor, the coolant, smoothing and any motion. Every motion handler (`onRapid`, `onProbeMove`, ...) calls `startPreamble()` first. A rotary index (`A` in `onRapid`) is written after it as well. So the M5 comes before every first move, on every path.
- Its condition is the same as fanuc's `probeStop` (#574). A cutting section clears `spindleWait` in the S/M3 branch, so it can never take the M5.
- The test is real. With line 556 removed, `probe_spindle_stop` fails with `doosan-dnm: no M5 between the tool change and the first move`. With the line, it passes.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `probe_spindle_stop` | 2/2 pass (fails without the fix) |
| app `doosan_dnm_post` | 7/7 |
| app `conformance` | 6/6 |
| app `fourth_axis_pose` | 9/9 |
| app `post_unit_word` | 5/5 |
| `camcraft-post` (all suites) | all green except `script_tormach_plasma`: 8 fail - **a main break, not this PR** (below) |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --lib --test probe_spindle_stop -D warnings` | clean |

No golden changes. The doosan-dnm recorded goldens (`crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/doosan-dnm/*`) and `script_doosan_dnm` (9/9) stay green, which confirms that none of them posts a zero-speed section.

I also posted a throwaway three-section probe on the merged post (local only):
- **Cut T1 then probe T1:** `S8000 M3` ... `M9`, `M5`, then `T01 M6`, `G43 H01`, `M5`, `M8`, then motion.
- **Probe T99 then cut T1, and probe T99 then cut T99:** the probe section gets `M5` before its first move. The cutting section after it gets `S8000 M3` and no M5.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. A same-tool probe after a cut writes `M5` twice: the previous section's end `M5`, then the preamble's. This is harmless, and it is what fanuc and the other #574 posts do.
2. The probe section still writes `M8` (flood is the dump default). That is outside this PR. #1034 gates the coolant line, as the decision file says.
3. Main is currently red in two places, both unrelated to this PR:
   - `camcraft-post --test script_tormach_plasma`: 8 recorded goldens are stale against #998's new refusal text ("no machine is stated, so none is declared a plasma machine"). #1002 and #998 crossed.
   - `camcraft-app` lib tests do not compile: `crates/app/src/operation/rotary_law_tests.rs:27` is missing the new `Cutter::neck` field (#957 x #1064).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
